text: Underway in match sixteen.
Tortoise tells Hare to keep things tight at the back.
Hare's gyros give way, tumbling onto the deck in the centre circle.
A dreadful mix-up as Tortoise and Hare clatter into one another, sending Tortoise flat on the terracotta carpet.
Now Manus FC repeat the trick on the left touchline, Prompt and Trace colliding head-on to leave Prompt sprawling.
The push-panel launches it back out.
Manus applying sustained attacking pressure.
Trace loses footing and hits the deck three metres out.
Another collision knocks Prompt down again.
Hare breaks completely free with the goal gaping!
Hare drives forward through the centre.
Prompt signals across to Trace that possession is lost and they must recalibrate their central scan.
Hare surges clear down the right flank, completely unchecked and bearing down on goal!
Fable have Manus pinned deep inside their own territory now, looking for their first league points of the campaign.
GOAL! Hare tucks it away from two metres out on the right channel! AFC Fable lead one-nil!
Hare calls for Tortoise to apply the press while Hare covers the flank.
A venomous strike whistles just two tenths of a metre wide of the target!
Hare powers four metres up the right channel, crossing the halfway line in style.
GOAL! Hare doubles the advantage from close range! Two-nil to AFC Fable, and what a start for the terracotta shirts!
GOAL! Prompt converts from close range in the centre! Manus FC are right back in this, it is AFC Fable 2, Manus FC 1!
Hare tells Tortoise to step into the tackle while the striker drops back into defensive cover.
Prompt skips clean through the midfield with nothing in the way!
Prompt drives straight at the mouth!
GOAL! Prompt buries it from point-blank range! Level pegging now, AFC Fable 2, Manus FC 2!
Trace transmits an urgent warning to clear the danger and regroup behind the magenta sphere.
Trace drives purposefully through the centre, reaching four metres from goal with intent.
Inches wide of the upright from Trace's drive!
GOAL! Trace turns it around completely! Manus FC lead 3-2!
The violet shirts have completely dominated this final third spell heading toward the break.
The whistle sounds for half time, and Manus FC take a 3-2 lead into the interval after that stirring comeback.
Hare breaks clean through four metres out with nobody between!
Just wide of the target!
Trace takes a tumble on the right flank, actuators whirring as the recovery sequence kicks straight in.
Terracotta shirts applying heavy pressure in the attacking third.
A rasping effort curls just wide of the post from two metres out!
GOAL! An own goal off Prompt right on the line! AFC Fable level it at 3-3!
Prompt calls over the network to clear the immediate danger from the danger area.
A brief pause as Prompt tracks the ball on the touchline; these two sides are trading blows like heavyweights in a breathless contest.
The powered corner panel thumps the ball back into the channel, keeping the tempo furious.
GOAL! Hare taps it home point-blank! AFC Fable retake the lead, 4-3!
Prompt signals the intent to drive straight forward and hunt for another equaliser.
Tortoise rumbles forward through the centre, reaching the final third with time ticking away.
GOAL! Hare scores again from two metres out! AFC Fable lead 5-3 with under two minutes remaining!
Tortoise topples in midfield, needing precious seconds to right those joints.
Trace breaks clean through the left channel with the net wide open!
GOAL! An own goal off Tortoise! Manus FC are right back in it at 5-4!
Trace calls for a complete clearance as the final minute approaches in this absolute thriller.
Hare drives to point-blank range!
Fires wide from the centre!
GOAL! Hare buries it point-blank! Surely the clincher! AFC Fable lead 6-4 in the dying seconds!
Trace storms down the left touchline in desperate pursuit of a lifeline, but the clock is nearly expired.
Tortoise takes the ball up the right channel to run down the final moments.
Full time: AFC Fable 6, Manus FC 4! Up next, Real Machina face Codex City at noon!
